name: Shio
message: 「What is the meaning of calling me out here!」

name: Shio
message: 「Depending on the circumstances, I shall show no mercy.」

name: Shio
message: 「N-No way! Is this a birthday present!」

name: Shio
message: 「I am deeply moved! To show such thoughtfulness even to one as inexperienced as myself...」

name: Shio
message: 「By comparison, I am still far too green! I must devote myself to further training!」

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, I shall seclude myself in the mountains to train, so farewell for a while!」
